steps.expect: (() => { const T = N.THREE, c = G.camera, w = new T.Vector3(-1.0, 5.35, -42.3), v = w.clone().project(c), o = c.getWorldPosition(new T.Vector3()), d = w.clone().sub(o), L = d.length(); d.divideScalar(L); const rc = new T.Raycaster(o, d, 0.1, L + 1); const h = rc.intersectObjects(G.stage.scene.children, true).find((q) => q.object.visible); return Math.abs(v.x) < 0.3 && Math.abs(v.y) < 0.3 && !!h && h.distance > L - 0.4; })()

steps.walk: (() => { const bs = G.interact.list.filter((q) => /bottle/.test(q.id)).map((q) => q.at()); const e = G.eye; const a = bs.sort((p, q) => Math.hypot(p.x - e.x, p.z - e.z) - Math.hypot(q.x - e.x, q.z - e.z))[0]; const d = Math.hypot(e.x - a.x, e.z - a.z); return d < 1.3 ? [[e.x, e.z]] : [[a.x + (e.x - a.x) / d * 1.0, a.z + (e.z - a.z) / d * 1.0]]; })()
steps.label: (the stick's walk ends a little wide of the keyboard's: the last step to the crate, within reach of the nearest bottle)

steps.look: (() => { const bs = G.interact.list.filter((q) => /bottle/.test(q.id)).map((q) => q.at()); const e = G.eye, c = N.controller; const a = bs.sort((p, q) => Math.hypot(p.x - e.x, p.z - e.z) - Math.hypot(q.x - e.x, q.z - e.z))[0]; const yw = Math.atan2(-(a.x - e.x), -(a.z - e.z)), pt = Math.atan2(a.y - e.y, Math.hypot(a.x - e.x, a.z - e.z)); const ey = Math.atan2(Math.sin(yw - c.yaw), Math.cos(yw - c.yaw)); return [Math.round(-ey / c.sensitivity), Math.round(-(pt - c.pitch) / c.sensitivity)]; })()

steps.look: (() => { const c = N.controller, e = Math.atan2(Math.sin(-1.41 - c.yaw), Math.cos(-1.41 - c.yaw)), ep = -0.05 - c.pitch; return [Math.round(-e / c.sensitivity), Math.round(-ep / c.sensitivity)]; })()
